title: Season Clock
subtitle: Turn a quiet year, one leaf at a time.
description: Explore three original illustrated landscapes through an imagined year of snowmelt, growth, blossom, summer, and falling leaves. Scrub a reversible seasonal timeline, change the pace, and save an exact SVG still. Every leaf, breeze, and snowflake follows the selected time.
instruction: Drag the year or visit a season. Play to watch it unfold; save an SVG still to keep the moment.
